program:
app "Match Scores Pro" ball ocean
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool, out bool
setting overs num = 20
let legal = count(ball today where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs today) + count(ball today where wide = yes)
let wkts = count(ball today where out = yes)
runs "/" wkts big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) + legal % 6 / 10 "of" overs faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 1
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes
  button "Undo" tap remove last(ball today)
describe:
Match Scores Pro, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- ball: runs: number, 0 to 6, starts at 0; wide: yes or no; out: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: overs: number, starts at 20.
Works out:
- legal is how many ball entries today where wide is no.
- runs is the total runs of ball today plus how many ball entries today where wide is yes.
- wkts is how many ball entries today where out is yes.
Shows:
- text: runs, "/", wkts.
- text: "Overs", legal divided by 6 rounded down plus legal leaves over when divided by 6 divided by 10, "of", overs.
- for 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6:
  - a button the value; a tap adds a ball with runs set to the value.
- a button "Wide"; a tap adds a ball with wide set to yes.
- a button "Out"; a tap adds a ball with out set to yes.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest ball entries today, with undo.

app "Daily Committee" users plum
table member name text, ord num 1..60
table pay member ref member, amount money
table payout member ref member
setting contribution money = 5000 "Monthly contribution"
let turn_no = count(payout) % count(member) + 1
"This month's turn" head
each member where ord = turn_no as m
  stack card gap 1
    m.name big
    "gets" contribution * count(member) faint
    button "Pot given" tap add payout member = m
count(pay month) "of" count(member) "have paid this month" head
each member sort ord as m
  row card gap 1
    m.ord bold
    m.name grow
    if(count(m.payout) > 0, "Received", "") color good faint
    if count(m.pay month) > 0
      "Paid" color good
    else
      button "Paid" tap add pay member = m, amount = contribution

describe:

- turn no is how many payout entries leaves over when divided by how many member entries plus 1.

program:
app "Hangman" board ink
table wrong letter text
let bad_n = count(wrong)
draw 100, 100 width 160
  line 10, 95, 90, 95 stroke ink thick 2
  line 25, 95, 25, 10 stroke ink thick 2
  line 25, 10, 60, 10 stroke ink thick 2
  line 60, 10, 60, 22 stroke ink thick 2
  if bad_n >= 1
    circle 60, 30, 8 stroke ink thick 2
  if bad_n >= 2
    line 60, 38, 60, 62 stroke ink thick 2
  if bad_n >= 3
    line 60, 44, 48, 55 stroke ink thick 2
  if bad_n >= 4
    line 60, 44, 72, 55 stroke ink thick 2
  if bad_n >= 5
    line 60, 62, 50, 78 stroke ink thick 2
  if bad_n >= 6
    line 60, 62, 70, 78 stroke ink thick 2
if bad_n >= 6
  "Out of tries" head color bad
form wrong, "Wrong letter"
button "New word" tap remove all wrong
describe:
Hangman, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- wrong: letter: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- bad n is how many wrong entries.
Shows:
